delivery_delay.name: delivery_delay
delivery_delay.description: Order or package has not arrived by the promised, guaranteed, or expected delivery date. Customer is reporting lateness, not a fully missing/lost package.
examples: Last month I ordered a wifi extender & paid $15 for next day delivery. It arrived 24 hr after. I was promised a refund. W/is it?
Really pissed right now. Paid for 2 day shipping and item never arrived. Now wont be delivered until Friday
Prime says guaranteed delivery within 2 days and now email it says delivery in 4 days

delivery_not_received.name: delivery_not_received
delivery_not_received.description: Tracking/carrier shows the package as delivered (or a delivery attempt was made), but the customer says they did not actually receive it -- distinct from delivery_delay because there is no further "in transit" status to check; this typically requires an investigation/claim rather than just waiting.
examples: my package shows delivered but I did not receive it. I've asked postal service and apartment manager and nothing!
says they delivered a package but didn't.
Where d hell is my package, it's showing as it is in Chennai frm day1.

order_status_inquiry.name: order_status_inquiry
order_status_inquiry.description: General question about the current status of an order (tracking, order ID lookup) without an explicit complaint framing -- the customer wants information, not necessarily compensation.
examples: Struggling to get solution from last 20 days. Order (405-1322311-9018741) was placed on 12th aug and return requested.
Order status shows delivered bt havnt rcvd. CS says technical glitch but other says need to verify with courier.

cancellation_or_refund_request.name: cancellation_or_refund_request
cancellation_or_refund_request.description: Customer explicitly wants to cancel an order, or is requesting or following up on a refund (including refund amount/timeline disputes). Financial-action intent.
examples: wrost service from amazon. my refund still not initiated in my account
please can you tell me why it is taken you over 1 month to refund me my money back after sending a parcel back to you??
Want to cancel order please

payment_or_billing_issue.name: payment_or_billing_issue
payment_or_billing_issue.description: Problem with a charge, payment method, or Amazon Pay balance -- being charged multiple times, payment declined, incorrect amount charged. Financial-action intent, account-specific verification usually required.
examples: My card has been charged 3 times for prime membership I have cancelled 3x now. Out $321, still don't have the funds
I've had payments declined 12 times on Amazon. each time you say it's working I try again
purchased prime membership by adding gift card to pay balance. Will i eligible for rs. 250 cashback.

account_access_issue.name: account_access_issue
account_access_issue.description: Customer is locked out of their account, believes it was hacked, or had account details (email, region) changed without their action. Security-sensitive.
examples: An outside third party has changed the email address on my account and I cannot get into the account to change it back
I've been locked out of my account due to something with my card
-had my account hacked & they've switched email address - now Russian!

return_or_replacement_request.name: return_or_replacement_request
return_or_replacement_request.description: Customer received a wrong, damaged, defective, or counterfeit product and wants a return, replacement, or exchange (as opposed to simply wanting money back, though these can overlap).
examples: Got a phone with some defects. Tried for exchange but neither you provide hand2hand exchange nor u provide a spare phone.
I ordered apple SE 32 gb on 17th oct 2017 but i got today a itel phone wich is cost 1690/-. What should i do?
i don't like the product,, i want refund.. can u help

prime_membership_issue.name: prime_membership_issue
prime_membership_issue.description: Question or complaint specifically about Prime membership itself -- signup, billing, benefits, or Prime's delivery-speed promise as a membership-value issue (distinct from a one-off delivery_delay).
examples: activated a free trial of amazon prime about an hour ago and it still says your membership should be active in a few minutes...
any reason why prime delivery of products showing as Monday? I ordered something on Friday thinking it would arrive today.

app_or_device_technical_issue.name: app_or_device_technical_issue
app_or_device_technical_issue.description: Technical bug or malfunction in an Amazon app, Kindle, Alexa/Echo, or Fire TV -- not an order/delivery issue at all.
examples: Fed up with this automatic fast forward bug in your nonsense app.
Could you plz add Text to Speech in Android app.. I hv been requesting this from ages.
I get messages like 'I don't know how to complete that request.' [Alexa]

content_availability_inquiry.name: content_availability_inquiry
content_availability_inquiry.description: Question about whether specific content (a show, movie, season, or book) is available, in what region, or when it will be released -- a Prime Video / Kindle catalog question, not a technical bug report.
examples: when will MR.ROBOT season 3 be live?
That stuff doesn't available on Amazon India. What should I ...
In item page its showing COD eligible ... but on checkout page its showing POD not available.

customer_service_complaint.name: customer_service_complaint
customer_service_complaint.description: General dissatisfaction or venting about support quality itself ("worst customer service", "pathetic") without a distinct, actionable request beyond "fix this." High escalation risk because there is often no single retrievable resolution -- the underlying issue is usually one of the other intents, expressed as a complaint about *how* it was (mis)handled.
examples: the #worst #experience with your service.. call me back
Very poor customer service. My acc got locked, raised complaint, more than 24 hrs, no revert.
amazon you have the worst customer service I have ever experienced

general_other.name: general_other
general_other.description: Does not clearly fit another category -- includes promotional/ off-topic mentions, ambiguous one-line messages, multi-topic messages, and messages that need more context than the root message alone provides. This is the deliberate "I'm not sure" bucket rather than forcing a low-confidence fit into another intent; it should route toward escalation/abstention, not toward a guessed intent.
examples: People why are call being ignored on to reach out you it's pain full
Am I not being understood? What reply do you expect?
